title: Dali Brain
tagline: Dali Brain is a ML project using Filecoin, Lighthouse as hot storage and computing layer. Deployed smart contract on FEVM to build the market place for machine learning resource sharing for commercial data economy.
description: This solution uses IPFS and Filecoin to advance mathematical research and hot storage by integrating the Lean theorem prover with a customized reward system. It can utilize custom instructions, context, and prompts, as well as specific files for data retrieval (Retrieval Augmented Generation or RAG).
